meta.title: Bulk upload vendors from the Excel template
gaps: Create and fill a completed Excel workbook with the specified vendor details; no catalog step supports generating or editing the required workbook.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Create and fill a completed Excel workbook with the specified vendor details; no catalog step supports generating or editing the required workbook.

args.goal: As the buyer, open the Vendors tab from the left navigation, click Bulk Upload, click New Upload, download the Sample Template, populate it with the several provided vendor details, upload the completed Excel workbook, press OK, wait for processing, and stop on the Prospects tab showing every uploaded vendor.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated vendor-management or bulk-upload flow, so this executes the missing UI workflow in the current buyer session.
Confirms the post-upload destination is the Prospects tab.
Checks that multiple uploaded vendor rows are present in the Prospects list.
